name: Asset Class 2
definition: Structure for defining asset class specific details of a derivative to be declared.

Commodity.name: Commodity
Commodity.definition: The fields in this section should only be populated for instruments that have non-financial instrument of type commodity as underlying.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: The fields in this section should only be populated for instruments that have non-financial instrument of type interest rates as underlying.

ForeignExchange.name: Foreign Exchange
ForeignExchange.definition: The fields in this section should only be populated for instruments that have non-financial instrument of type foreign exchange as underlying.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one of the 3 elements must be present.
